description: Replaces the schedules of a report of any type, at most 10; an empty list removes them all. Only its editors may. A scheduled run updates the whole report: an AI update on a SlideDeck report, and a refresh of every sync on a report of another type, or only the `syncIds` a schedule names. Schedules are checked every 15 minutes, so a cron that fires more often still runs at most once per 15 minutes.

schedules.description: The report's new schedules. They replace all of its current schedules, so read them with `getReportSchedules` first and include any you want to keep, with their `syncIds`; send an empty list to remove them all. When several schedules fall at the same time, the report runs once. Up to 10.

cronExpression.description: When a `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly` or `quarterly` schedule runs: a five-field cron expression (minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week) in the schedule's `timezone`, such as `0 9 * * 1` for every Monday at 9:00, or `0 9 L * *` for 9:00 on the last day of each month. Required for those frequencies; omit it for `hourly`. Rollstack checks schedules every 15 minutes, so the minute field must include 0, 15, 30 or 45, and runs at other minutes are skipped. At most 100 characters.

endDate.description: When the schedule ends: it never runs the report after this date and time. Omit it or pass `null` for a schedule that never ends. Like `startDate`, this is a local date and time in the schedule's `timezone`, written as if it were UTC. Must be later than `startDate`. Set it later than the last run you want: a run at exactly this time may be skipped.

frequency.description: How often the schedule runs. `hourly` runs every day at each time in `selectedTimes`, and takes no `cronExpression`. `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly` and `quarterly` run whenever `cronExpression` fires, and take no `selectedTimes`. For those, the frequency doesn't change when the report runs, but the app uses it to describe and edit the schedule, so pick the one that matches your cron expression.

selectedTimes.description: The times of day an `hourly` schedule runs, every day, as 24-hour `HH:mm` in the schedule's `timezone`, such as `09:00` or `13:45`. Required for `hourly`; omit it for other frequencies. Each time must be on the quarter hour (`:00`, `:15`, `:30` or `:45`). From 1 to 96 times.

startDate.description: When the schedule starts: it never runs the report before this date and time. This is a local date and time in the schedule's `timezone`, written as if it were UTC: `2026-11-02T09:00:00Z` means 9:00 on November 2, 2026 in that timezone, not 9:00 UTC. For frequencies other than `hourly`, set it to the date and time of the first run: the app shows its time as the schedule's time, and when someone changes the schedule's frequency or days there, it rebuilds `cronExpression` at that time.

syncIds.description: The syncs, from `listReportSyncs`, that the schedule updates on a report other than a `SlideDeck`. `null` when it updates the whole report, which a slide deck always does. Omit it or pass `null` to update the whole report. Each id must be a sync of this report, so it only works on a report other than a `SlideDeck`. Keep the `syncIds` `getReportSchedules` returns for schedules you don't mean to change. A sync deleted later is skipped, so a schedule whose syncs are all gone updates nothing.

timezone.description: The timezone the schedule runs in. Its run times (`cronExpression` or `selectedTimes`), `startDate` and `endDate` are all local times in this timezone, so a schedule set for 9:00 keeps running at 9:00 local time when daylight saving time starts or ends. Given as an IANA timezone name, such as `America/New_York`. UTC offsets such as `+05:30` aren't accepted.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

id.description: The report to act on, of any `type`, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack (`appUrl`): it's the part right after `/slides/` or `/destinations/`.

name: updateReportSchedules
title: Replace report schedules
